- The user and group mapping feature is currently in invitational preview. To use this feature, [submit a ticket](https://smartservice.console.aliyun.com/service/create-ticket?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.24241ee9gQPwnE) to request access.  
- Permission Management for Apsara File Storage for HDFS file systems depends on the user and group associated with each file. You must manage user and group mappings through OpenAPI. For more information about folder and file access permissions in Apsara File Storage for HDFS, see [Folder and File Access Permissions](~~430865~~).  

- There are limits on the number of users and groups per file system:  
  - A single file system supports up to 1,000 users.

ListUserGroupsMappings.title: View User and Group Mapping
ListUserGroupsMappings.description:
Permission Management for Apsara File Storage for HDFS file systems depends on users and groups associated with files. The user and group mappings must be managed through OpenAPI. For information about folder and file access permissions in Apsara File Storage for HDFS file systems, see [Folder and File Access Permissions](~~430865~~).

A single file system has limits on the number of users and groups, including:
- A maximum of 1,000 users can be added to a single file system.
- A maximum of 30 groups can be added to a single file system.
- Each user can belong to a maximum of 10 groups.

schema.description: Region ID.

Name of the permission group. The naming convention is as follows:

- The length must be 6 to 64 characters.

- It must be globally unique and cannot be empty.

- It supports English letters and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
Description of the permission group.

ModifyAccessRule.title: Modify Permission Group Rule
ModifyAccessRule.description: Rules in the VPC default permission group (DefaultAccessGroupName) cannot be modified.

schema.description: Region ID.

File system name. The naming convention is as follows:

- Length must be between 6 and 64 characters.
- Must be globally unique and cannot be an empty string.
- Supports English letters and may include digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

File system capacity quota.

When the actual data storage reaches the file system capacity, no further data can be written. The file system capacity cannot be reduced.

Unit: GB

File system description.

The length cannot exceed 32 characters.
